name: 1 µm cellular ROI (VOI1)
comparison_note: The 1, 5 and 20 µm levels here show exactly the same 0.32 mm tissue crop. The 5 and 20 µm levels are block means derived from native 1 µm data. The separate original 20 µm dataset shows a different region; these two crops are not atlas aligned.

source.title: Huysegoms et al. 1 µm reconstructed VOI1
source.dataset: Cellular level 3D reconstructed volumes at 1 µm resolution within the BigBrain occipital cortex (v1.0), VOI1
source.reference: Huysegoms, Bludau, Oliveira, Upschulte, Dickscheid and Amunts (2022), EBRAINS, DOI:10.25493/K8Q7-CG9
source.coordinate_system: Local VOI source-grid coordinates. The published atlas registration affine is not applied by this viewer.
source.selection: Central 320³ demonstration crop; not a scientific sampling procedure
